BillHeading.BriefDescription: Making the property tax exemption for multipurpose senior citizen centers permanent.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to making the property tax exemption for multipurpose senior citizen centers permanent; and creating a new section.

BillSectionHeader.P: RCW 83.32.805 does not apply to the tax preference created in section 2, chapter 301, Laws of 2017.
